covers: Contradiction between the request and the RoPA: a requested data category the provider doesn't hold
title: Registered wages for payroll declaration audits

F-R1.quote: To check that the payroll costs employers declare in their tax returns match the wages they registered for social insurance.

F-R2.quote: PDPL Article 15(3): disclosure requested by a public entity to implement another law, namely the Income Tax Law.

F-R3.quote: Assessing the zakat and tax due on employers' correct taxable base, a function given to the Authority by the Income Tax Law.

F-R4.quote: Employee name, national ID number, employer establishment number, registered monthly wage, employee bank account number.

F-R5.quote: Kept for five years after the related tax audit is closed, then destroyed.

F-R6.quote: Requested by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority from the General Organization for Social Insurance.

F-P1.quote: General Organization for Social Insurance, Data Management Office, privacy@gosi.example

F-P2.quote: Registering private-sector employees and their wages to calculate and collect social insurance contributions and pay benefits, and providing registered wage information to government entities that verify employers' declarations under the law.

F-P3.quote: Processing required to implement the Social Insurance Law.

F-P4.quote: Employee name, national ID number, date of birth, employer establishment number, registered monthly wage, contribution history.

F-P5.quote: Private-sector employees registered for social insurance, and employers' authorised representatives.

F-P6.quote: Government entities that verify employers' declarations under the law, including the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority; other government entities where a law requires disclosure.

F-P7.quote: No transfer or disclosure outside the Kingdom.

F-P8.quote: Contribution records are kept for the employee's insured life and ten years after the final benefit is paid.
